entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that offers a universal memory layer for User, Session, and Agent states. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval and is available as an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and hybrid RAG search. It provides automated fact extraction and maintains user profiles with connectors for Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing. It implements tiered L0/L1/L2 data loading and provides observable retrieval with directory-browsing trajectories.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain for Hermes Agents provides synthesized answers complete with citations and gap analysis. It supports multi-user scoping for team institutional memory and creates typed edges without LLM calls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system designed for long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents and offers Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages context trees using git-like version control via brv vc commit, branch, and merge. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that utilizes a single SQLite database. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system that combines vector search and structured facts with an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets. It supports multiple agent providers, including Pi and MCP clients, and includes CLI tools for task investigation.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a DAG-based engine to prevent message loss. It utilizes a SQLite-backed message store with FTS metadata to build depth-aware summaries for compacted history.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This project provides a shared memory layer that stores information as plain-text YAML engrams. It supports Hermes and offers local-first, zero-cost search for multi-agent systems.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This layer provides local-first identity, memory, and secrets with local custody of SQLite and workspace files. It is designed to provide portable state across Hermes Agent and other clients, averaging 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine uses hybrid retrieval, including BM25, vector search, and graph traversal, without cloud dependencies. It integrates with Hermes plugins and automates decision capture using a local GGUF observer model.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem and reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3×.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This is a durable, file-based long-term memory architecture that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases. It includes a five-package plugin family featuring a Hermes adapter.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching why_retrieved tags to every retrieval. It is embedded by default and includes features like contradiction tracking and recency ranking.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by watching agent session logs. It utilizes local-first storage via SQLite-vec and GGUF models.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide evidence packets per query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead through local BM25 tool ranking and keyword selection. It is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and includes a dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to reduce prompt tokens by 94%. It renders workspace facts into files like AGENTS.md and supports MCP via stdio or SSE.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This project provides long-term, cross-project memory by storing information as inspectable Markdown files. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and operates without opaque databases.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to manage memories. It features importance-weighted recall via a 1-10 ranking system and supports BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory system that supports real, immediate event deletion. It includes an on-demand summarizer and maintains a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage state updates and searches.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server facilitates API payments across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families using USDC and stablecoins. It integrates with Hermes to enable AI agents to pay for API usage.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both embedded and multi-mode execution via Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon. It offers HNSW, sparse, FM-index, and bitmap indexing for dense and exact-text recall.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides local capability indexing and routing through five native tools for searching, fetching, and reporting on artifacts. It supports indexing for scripts, markdown documents, cron jobs, MCP servers, and skills.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It employs a hybrid search method combining vector, BM25, and graph techniques, and includes automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories via semantic and literal code search. It runs on localhost and supports grounded Q&A featuring file-and-line citations.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a library of composable skills and utilizes a subagent-driven-development methodology for task execution. It is essential for agents requiring a structured design refinement and brainstorming phase.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first prototyping system supports HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 exports while offering CLI support for coding agents. It enables automation and plugin features within a design system environment.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It is compatible with Python, Rust, and TypeScript clients.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 structured cybersecurity skills mapped across 29 security domains and six industry frameworks. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities for generating diagrams from natural language.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns using a two-pass detection process. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Cursor.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project facilitates collective skill evolution for shared user teams through automated deduplication and quality improvement. It provides unified skill libraries across multiple agents and devices.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 12 metaskills designed for guided business and code journeys. It is compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication, escrow, and dispute resolution. It includes a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and payments.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers 822 professional skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It provides ready-to-paste exports for use with ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, and Codex.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation via slash commands.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent and other compatible agents. It extracts transcripts, captions, and timestamps without using yt-dlp.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It includes pre-built analytical lenses for various domains and reports findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This library provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI using modular packages of instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different project complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running AI agents through a three-level work model. It provides structured memory using file-backed or SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for task and card management.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This integration follows the Agent Skills specification to support CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. It includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services to facilitate smart contract interaction.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It includes API integration patterns for polling, webhooks, and error handling, alongside support for JSON structured prompting.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned instruction files by converting repositories, documentation, or developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It provides provenance through file:line citations or documentation URLs.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This repository provides Hermes Agent skills in SKILL.md format and installation guides in Portuguese. It includes integrations for various communication channels.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, multi-step tasks. It features real-time tracking of progress and decisions, along with built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This workflow language for AI uses a single Rust binary and four verbs to implement Intent as Code. It provides static auditing via nika check and generates tamper-evident execution receipts using hash-chaining.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables management of files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and performs incremental discovery of tool schemas and server metadata.

entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across surfaces including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to model family and reasoning capability while tracking quality scores and token savings in a local SQLite database.

entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This tool generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It produces structured reports containing core conclusions and action suggestions while utilizing semantic memory to integrate user interests for search expansion.

entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module provides declarative configuration for workspace documents and cli-config.yaml. It features hybrid skill management and integrates secure secrets via sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane allows for the deployment, monitoring, and operation of Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps through a REST API, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate identities and workspaces. It features hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM-based analysts, including fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical roles, to perform financial trading. It incorporates risk and portfolio management and supports local Ollama models alongside various LLM providers.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform manages multi-agent workflows and monitors spend across frameworks like CrewAI, LangGraph, and AutoGen. It provides a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API for task tracking and scheduling.

entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This framework employs a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for delegating tasks between orchestrators and specialists. It features bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using multiple model providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management using Hermes Agent profiles. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates evaluations for TBLite and TerminalBench-2 while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for local execution. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling and is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This Rust-powered kernel creates a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux and provides automatic project synchronization.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool and visualization dashboard tracks token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents. It supports data from clients including Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows users to inspect real API traffic and agent context from Hermes Agent and other tools. It enables comparison of adjacent requests and supports exporting local traces to self-contained HTML viewers.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown or general prompting and integrates with Hermes Agent.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of token usage, account limits, and session details with multi-device synchronization. It reads Hermes Agent state directly and offers historical usage trends and breakdowns.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build, ship, and operate apps with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows and supports autonomous execution on VPS or laptops.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project provides community CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can customize banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art banners using YAML-based configuration.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous AI agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without separate processes or OAuth and includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is built for autonomous agent control via MCP. It supports Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama, and includes a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows alongside action undo and session snapshots.

entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of hermes-agent and over 12 supporting services to deploy a stack in minutes. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs deterministic, local checks on AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It analyzes JSON, YAML, Markdown, and Python files and supports integration via GitHub Actions and pre-commit.

entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides passive monitoring and active probing modes to monitor and auto-recover multi-agent systems without cloud dependency. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and uses local configuration files for config-aware baselines.

entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard providing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.

entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for Hermes Agent running on Orgo cloud computers and SSH hosts. It includes one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and tools for managing profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that runs locally. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that connects to local agents via a Postgres message bus. It features an approval inbox for requests involving side effects.

entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client for orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and streaming SSE responses.
